itemId.description: The identifier of the group: up to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores. A group without a valid itemId is refused.

displayText.description: The name of the group. A group without a name is refused.

parentId.description: The itemId of the group this group is nested in, or null for a top-level group.

order.description: The position of the group among its siblings.

createdUtc.description: The time the group was created.

modifiedUtc.description: The time the group was last changed.

items.description: A report group, which files reports in a tree.

Groups.description: The report groups, imported before the views and reports. A group is matched by its itemId and replaced, or created under that identifier. A group whose parent is missing once every group is in moves to the top level.

itemId.description: The identifier of the view: up to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores. A view without a valid itemId is refused.

displayText.description: The title of the view. A view without a title is refused.

alias.description: The alias fields of this data set are named by, as in 'alias.Field'.

source.description: The name of the data source, as registered by the features that provide data (for example Contents, Users, Queries or ReportViews).

dataSet.description: The data set within the source, such as a content type, a query name or the itemId of a view.

displayName.description: The label of the data set in the designer.

dataSets.description: The data sets the query reads. The first is the base data set; the others are attached by joins.

alias.description: The alias of the data set being joined.

leftField.description: The field key on the left side, as 'alias.Field'.

rightField.description: The field key on the right side, as 'alias.Field'.

conditions.description: The field pairs that must be equal.

joins.description: How the data sets are joined, applied in order.

name.description: The name the field is referred to by.

expression.description: The formula. A row-level field may refer only to data set fields and to calculated fields listed before it.

id.description: The identifier of the filter, unique within the query. Exposed filter values are submitted under it.

field.description: What the filter applies to: a field key ('alias.Field' or a calculated field name) for the Rows stage, or a column id for the Result stage.

stage.description: Whether the filter applies to rows before grouping or to the result after grouping.

values.description: The comparison values in the invariant culture (dates as yyyy-MM-dd or yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm in the tenant time zone). For an exposed filter, the default values.

exposed.description: Whether the filter is rendered for the people who run the report.

label.description: The label of an exposed filter.

control.description: The control that renders an exposed filter.

id.description: The identifier of the column, unique within the query, which sorts and visuals refer to.

field.description: The field key the column reads: 'alias.Field' or a calculated field name.

aggregate.description: The aggregate that makes the column a measure, or None for a dimension.

transform.description: A transform applied to the field before grouping, such as a date part.

format.description: A .NET format string applied to the values.

hidden.description: Whether the column is computed but not shown.

shelf.description: The shelf a pivot places the column on.

colors.description: The colors of the column's header and cells: headerColor, headerBackgroundColor, color, backgroundColor, a color scale and color rules.

showAs.description: How a measure's values are shown.

showAsDirection.description: The direction a showAs calculation runs in a pivot.

items.description: A result column of a query.

columns.description: The result columns in display order. When any column is a measure, rows are grouped by the dimension columns.

columnId.description: The id of the column to sort by.

sorts.description: The sort order of the result.

limit.description: The most rows the result holds, or null for the default limit.

refreshIntervalMinutes.description: How often the view's result is computed ahead and stored: 0 runs it live on every read, otherwise at least every 15 minutes (60, 360 and 1440 are offered). Other values are normalized on import.

ownerId.description: The user id of the view's owner, whose access the view runs with. Used when OwnerUserName names no user of the site.

OwnerUserName.description: The user name of the view's owner, written by a deployment plan so the owner is found on a site where they have another user id. When neither this nor ownerId names an owner, the person who runs the recipe owns the view.

author.description: The name of the person who created the view.

createdUtc.description: The time the view was created.

modifiedUtc.description: The time the view was last changed. Set to the import time.

Views.description: The reusable views (saved queries that other reports and views read as the 'ReportViews' data source), imported before the reports. A view is matched by its itemId and replaced, or created under that identifier.

itemId.description: The identifier of the report: up to 64 letters, digits, dashes and underscores. A report without a valid itemId is refused.

displayText.description: The title of the report. A report without a title is refused.

groupId.description: The itemId of the report group the report is in. When no group has this identifier, the group is taken from 'group'.

group.description: A path of group names, such as 'Sales / Regional', used when groupId names no group. Missing groups along the path are created.

category.description: Obsolete. A top-level group name written before report groups existed; read only when neither groupId nor group places the report.

items.description: An extra query of a report.

queries.description: Extra queries the report runs besides the main query, so visuals can show the data grouped another way.

id.description: The identifier of the visual, unique within the report.

title.description: The title shown above the visual.

width.description: The width of the visual on a twelve-column grid (of its container's width when it is in one).

containerId.description: The id of the container that holds the visual, or null when it stands on its own.

queryId.description: The id of the extra query whose columns the visual shows, or null for the main query.

action.description: What clicking a value does: columnId names the clicked column and targets lists the visuals ({ visualId, field }) filtered by the value.

categoryColumnId.description: The id of the column that labels a chart's categories.

seriesColumnId.description: The id of a dimension column whose values become a chart's series or a pivot table's columns.

valueColumnIds.description: The ids of the measure columns a chart plots, a metrics row shows or a pivot table sums.

columnIds.description: The ids of the columns a table shows, in order (every visible column when empty), or the row columns of a pivot table.

showTotals.description: Whether a table or pivot table ends with a totals row.

showSubtotals.description: Whether a table of a grouped report shows subtotal rows after each group of its leading dimensions.

stacked.description: Whether a bar or area chart stacks its series.

showLegend.description: Whether a chart shows its legend.

columnId.description: The id of the value column the line belongs to.

kind.description: Whether the line marks the column's average, its median or a constant value.

value.description: The value of a Constant line.

referenceLines.description: Lines a chart draws across its values.

visuals.description: The tables, charts, metric rows and pivot tables of the report, in display order.

id.description: The identifier of the container, unique within the report, which visuals name in containerId.

title.description: The title shown in the container's header band.

width.description: The width of the container on a twelve-column grid.

height.description: The height of the container's body in pixels, which scrolls when its visuals are taller, or 0 to grow with its visuals.

containers.description: Framed blocks that hold visuals under one title.

showInAdminMenu.description: Whether the report is listed in the admin menu under Reports.

sharedUserNames.description: The user names the report is shared with.

sharedRoles.description: The role names the report is shared with.

allowExport.description: Whether the people who run the report may export it.

ownerId.description: The user id of the report's owner, whose access the report runs with. Used when OwnerUserName names no user of the site.

OwnerUserName.description: The user name of the report's owner, written by a deployment plan so the owner is found on a site where they have another user id. When neither this nor ownerId names an owner, the person who runs the recipe owns the report.

author.description: The name of the person who created the report.

createdUtc.description: The time the report was created.

modifiedUtc.description: The time the report was last changed. Set to the import time.

Reports.description: The designed reports. A report is matched by its itemId and replaced, or created under that identifier. Share links are never imported.
